versos.grego: Παῦλος κλητὸς ἀπόστολος Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ διὰ θελήματος Θεοῦ καὶ Σωσθένης ὁ ἀδελφὸς

controles.web: Paul, called to be an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God, and our brother Sosthenes,
controles.kjv: Paul, called to be an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God, and Sosthenes our brother,
controles.livre: Paulo, chamado apóstolo de Jesus Cristo pela vontade de Deus, e o irmão Sóstenes,

versos.grego: τῇ ἐκκλησίᾳ τοῦ Θεοῦ τῇ οὔσῃ ἐν Κορίνθῳ, ἡγιασμένοις ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ, κλητοῖς ἁγίοις, σὺν πᾶσιν τοῖς ἐπικαλουμένοις τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ ἐν παντὶ τόπῳ, αὐτῶν καὶ ἡμῶν·

controles.web: to the assembly of God which is at Corinth; those who are sanctified in Christ Jesus, called to be saints, with all who call on the name of our Lord Jesus Christ in every place, both theirs and ours:
controles.kjv: Unto the church of God which is at Corinth, to them that are sanctified in Christ Jesus, called to be saints, with all that in every place call upon the name of Jesus Christ our Lord, both theirs and ours:
controles.livre: À igreja de Deus que está em Corinto, aos santificados em Cristo Jesus, chamados santos, com todos os que em todo lugar invocam o nome de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo, Senhor deles, e nosso;

versos.grego: χάρις ὑμῖν καὶ εἰρήνη ἀπὸ Θεοῦ Πατρὸς ἡμῶν καὶ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ.

controles.web: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
controles.kjv: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.
controles.livre: Graça seja convosco, e a paz de Deus nosso Pai, e do Senhor Jesus Cristo.

versos.grego: Εὐχαριστῶ τῷ Θεῷ πάντοτε περὶ ὑμῶν ἐπὶ τῇ χάριτι τοῦ Θεοῦ τῇ δοθείσῃ ὑμῖν ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ,

controles.web: I always thank my God concerning you, for the grace of God which was given you in Christ Jesus;
controles.kjv: I thank my God always on your behalf, for the grace of God which is given you by Jesus Christ;
controles.livre: Sempre agradeço ao meu Deus por causa de vós, pela graça de Deus, que é dada a vós em Cristo Jesus.

versos.grego: ὅτι ἐν παντὶ ἐπλουτίσθητε ἐν αὐτῷ, ἐν παντὶ λόγῳ καὶ πάσῃ γνώσει,

controles.web: that in everything you were enriched in him, in all speech and all knowledge;
controles.kjv: That in every thing ye are enriched by him, in all utterance, and in all knowledge;
controles.livre: Que em todas as coisas estais enriquecidos nele, em toda palavra, e em todo conhecimento;

versos.grego: καθὼς τὸ μαρτύριον τοῦ Χριστοῦ ἐβεβαιώθη ἐν ὑμῖν,

controles.web: even as the testimony of Christ was confirmed in you:
controles.kjv: Even as the testimony of Christ was confirmed in you:
controles.livre: Assim como o testemunho de Jesus Cristo foi confirmado entre vós.

versos.grego: ὥστε ὑμᾶς μὴ ὑστερεῖσθαι ἐν μηδενὶ χαρίσματι, ἀπεκδεχομένους τὴν ἀποκάλυψιν τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ·

controles.web: so that you come behind in no gift; waiting for the revelation of our Lord Jesus Christ;
controles.kjv: So that ye come behind in no gift; waiting for the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ:
controles.livre: De maneira que nenhum dom vos falta, enquanto esperais a manifestação do nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo,

versos.grego: ὃς καὶ βεβαιώσει ὑμᾶς ἕως τέλους ἀνεγκλήτους ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ.

controles.web: who will also confirm you until the end, blameless in the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.
controles.kjv: Who shall also confirm you unto the end, that ye may be blameless in the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.
controles.livre: o qual também vos firmará até o fim, irrepreensíveis no dia de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo.

versos.grego: πιστὸς ὁ Θεὸς, δι’ οὗ ἐκλήθητε εἰς κοινωνίαν τοῦ Υἱοῦ αὐτοῦ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν.

controles.web: God is faithful, through whom you were called into the fellowship of his Son, Jesus Christ, our Lord.
controles.kjv: God is faithful, by whom ye were called unto the fellowship of his Son Jesus Christ our Lord.
controles.livre: Deus é fiel, por quem fostes chamados para a comunhão do seu Filho Jesus Cristo, nosso Senhor.

versos.grego: Παρακαλῶ δὲ ὑμᾶς, ἀδελφοί, διὰ τοῦ ὀνόματος τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, ἵνα τὸ αὐτὸ λέγητε πάντες, καὶ μὴ ᾖ ἐν ὑμῖν σχίσματα, ἦτε δὲ κατηρτισμένοι ἐν τῷ αὐτῷ νοῒ καὶ ἐν τῇ αὐτῇ γνώμῃ.

controles.web: Now I beg you, brothers, through the name of our Lord, Jesus Christ, that you all speak the same thing and that there be no divisions among you, but that you be perfected together in the same mind and in the same judgment.
controles.kjv: Now I beseech you, brethren, by the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that ye all speak the same thing, and that there be no divisions among you; but that ye be perfectly joined together in the same mind and in the same judgment.
controles.livre: Mas eu vos rogo, irmãos, pelo nome do nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo, que todos faleis uma mesma coisa, e não haja divisões entre vós; antes estejais juntos com o mesmo entendimento, e com a mesma opinião.

versos.grego: ἐδηλώθη γάρ μοι περὶ ὑμῶν, ἀδελφοί μου, ὑπὸ τῶν Χλόης, ὅτι ἔριδες ἐν ὑμῖν εἰσιν.

controles.web: For it has been reported to me concerning you, my brothers, by those who are from Chloe’s household, that there are contentions among you.
controles.kjv: For it hath been declared unto me of you, my brethren, by them which are of the house of Chloe, that there are contentions among you.
controles.livre: Porque, irmãos meus, me foi informado de vós, pelos da casa de Cloé, que há brigas entre vós.

versos.grego: λέγω δὲ τοῦτο, ὅτι ἕκαστος ὑμῶν λέγει Ἐγὼ μέν εἰμι Παύλου, Ἐγὼ δὲ Ἀπολλῶ, Ἐγὼ δὲ Κηφᾶ, Ἐγὼ δὲ Χριστοῦ.

controles.web: Now I mean this, that each one of you says, “I follow Paul,” “I follow Apollos,” “I follow Cephas,” and, “I follow Christ.”
controles.kjv: Now this I say, that every one of you saith, I am of Paul; and I of Apollos; and I of Cephas; and I of Christ.
controles.livre: E digo isto, que cada um de vós diz: “Eu sou de Paulo” e “Eu sou de Apolo” e “Eu sou de Cefas” e “Eu sou de Cristo”.

versos.grego: μεμέρισται ὁ Χριστός; μὴ Παῦλος ἐσταυρώθη ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν, ἢ εἰς τὸ ὄνομα Παύλου ἐβαπτίσθητε;

controles.web: Is Christ divided? Was Paul crucified for you? Or were you baptized into the name of Paul?
controles.kjv: Is Christ divided? was Paul crucified for you? or were ye baptized in the name of Paul?
controles.livre: Cristo está dividido? Paulo foi crucificado por vós? Ou fostes vós batizados no nome de Paulo?

versos.grego: εὐχαριστῶ ὅτι οὐδένα ὑμῶν ἐβάπτισα εἰ μὴ Κρίσπον καὶ Γάϊον·

controles.web: I thank God that I baptized none of you, except Crispus and Gaius,
controles.kjv: I thank God that I baptized none of you, but Crispus and Gaius;
controles.livre: Agradeço a Deus que batizei nenhum de vós, a não ser Crispo e Gaio;

versos.grego: ἵνα μή τις εἴπῃ ὅτι εἰς τὸ ἐμὸν ὄνομα ἐβαπτίσθητε.

controles.web: so that no one should say that I had baptized you into my own name.
controles.kjv: Lest any should say that I had baptized in mine own name.
controles.livre: para que ninguém diga que eu tenha batizado em meu nome.

versos.grego: ἐβάπτισα δὲ καὶ τὸν Στεφανᾶ οἶκον· λοιπὸν οὐκ οἶδα εἴ τινα ἄλλον ἐβάπτισα.

controles.web: (I also baptized the household of Stephanas; besides them, I don’t know whether I baptized any other.)
controles.kjv: And I baptized also the household of Stephanas: besides, I know not whether I baptized any other.
controles.livre: Também batizei aos da casa de Estefanas; além desses, não sei se batizei algum outro.

versos.grego: οὐ γὰρ ἀπέστειλέν με Χριστὸς βαπτίζειν ἀλλὰ εὐαγγελίζεσθαι, οὐκ ἐν σοφίᾳ λόγου, ἵνα μὴ κενωθῇ ὁ σταυρὸς τοῦ Χριστοῦ.

controles.web: For Christ sent me not to baptize, but to preach the Good News—not in wisdom of words, so that the cross of Christ wouldn’t be made void.
controles.kjv: For Christ sent me not to baptize, but to preach the gospel: not with wisdom of words, lest the cross of Christ should be made of none effect.
controles.livre: Porque Cristo não me enviou para batizar, mas sim, para evangelizar; não com sabedoria de palavras, para que a cruz de Cristo não se torne inútil.

versos.grego: Ὁ λόγος γὰρ ὁ τοῦ σταυροῦ τοῖς μὲν ἀπολλυμένοις μωρία ἐστίν, τοῖς δὲ σῳζομένοις ἡμῖν δύναμις Θεοῦ ἐστιν.

controles.web: For the word of the cross is foolishness to those who are dying, but to us who are saved it is the power of God.
controles.kjv: For the preaching of the cross is to them that perish foolishness; but unto us which are saved it is the power of God.
controles.livre: Porque a palavra da cruz é loucura para os que perecem; mas para os que se salvam é poder de Deus.

versos.grego: γέγραπται γάρ Ἀπολῶ τὴν σοφίαν τῶν σοφῶν, καὶ τὴν σύνεσιν τῶν συνετῶν ἀθετήσω.

controles.web: For it is written,  “I will destroy the wisdom of the wise, I will bring the discernment of the discerning to nothing.”
controles.kjv: For it is written, I will destroy the wisdom of the wise, and will bring to nothing the understanding of the prudent.
controles.livre: Porque está escrito: Destruirei a sabedoria dos sábios, e aniquilarei a inteligência dos inteligentes.

versos.grego: ποῦ σοφός; ποῦ γραμματεύς; ποῦ συνζητητὴς τοῦ αἰῶνος τούτου; οὐχὶ ἐμώρανεν ὁ Θεὸς τὴν σοφίαν τοῦ κόσμου;

controles.web: Where is the wise? Where is the scribe? Where is the lawyer of this world? Hasn’t God made foolish the wisdom of this world?
controles.kjv: Where is the wise? where is the scribe? where is the disputer of this world? hath not God made foolish the wisdom of this world?
controles.livre: Onde está o sábio? Onde está o escriba? Onde está o questionador destes tempos? Por acaso Deus não fez de loucura a sabedoria deste mundo?

versos.grego: ἐπειδὴ γὰρ ἐν τῇ σοφίᾳ τοῦ Θεοῦ οὐκ ἔγνω ὁ κόσμος διὰ τῆς σοφίας τὸν Θεόν, εὐδόκησεν ὁ Θεὸς διὰ τῆς μωρίας τοῦ κηρύγματος σῶσαι τοὺς πιστεύοντας.

controles.web: For seeing that in the wisdom of God, the world through its wisdom didn’t know God, it was God’s good pleasure through the foolishness of the preaching to save those who believe.
controles.kjv: For after that in the wisdom of God the world by wisdom knew not God, it pleased God by the foolishness of preaching to save them that believe.
controles.livre: Porque já que, na sabedoria de Deus, o mundo não conheceu a Deus pela sabedoria, Deus se agradou de salvar aos crentes pela loucura da pregação.

versos.grego: ἐπειδὴ καὶ Ἰουδαῖοι σημεῖα αἰτοῦσιν καὶ Ἕλληνες σοφίαν ζητοῦσιν,

controles.web: For Jews ask for signs, Greeks seek after wisdom,
controles.kjv: For the Jews require a sign, and the Greeks seek after wisdom:
controles.livre: Porque os judeus pedem sinal, e os gregos buscam sabedoria.

versos.grego: ἡμεῖς δὲ κηρύσσομεν Χριστὸν ἐσταυρωμένον, Ἰουδαίοις μὲν σκάνδαλον, ἔθνεσιν δὲ μωρίαν,

controles.web: but we preach Christ crucified; a stumbling block to Jews, and foolishness to Greeks,
controles.kjv: But we preach Christ crucified, unto the Jews a stumblingblock, and unto the Greeks foolishness;
controles.livre: Mas nós pregamos a Cristo crucificado, que é escândalo para os Judeus, e loucura para os gregos.

versos.grego: αὐτοῖς δὲ τοῖς κλητοῖς, Ἰουδαίοις τε καὶ Ἕλλησιν, Χριστὸν Θεοῦ δύναμιν καὶ Θεοῦ σοφίαν.

controles.web: but to those who are called, both Jews and Greeks, Christ is the power of God and the wisdom of God.
controles.kjv: But unto them which are called, both Jews and Greeks, Christ the power of God, and the wisdom of God.
controles.livre: Porém aos que são chamados, tanto judeus como gregos, Cristo é poder de Deus e sabedoria de Deus.

versos.grego: ὅτι τὸ μωρὸν τοῦ Θεοῦ σοφώτερον τῶν ἀνθρώπων ἐστίν, καὶ τὸ ἀσθενὲς τοῦ Θεοῦ ἰσχυρότερον τῶν ἀνθρώπων.

controles.web: Because the foolishness of God is wiser than men, and the weakness of God is stronger than men.
controles.kjv: Because the foolishness of God is wiser than men; and the weakness of God is stronger than men.
controles.livre: Porque a loucura de Deus é mais sábia que os seres humanos; e a fraqueza de Deus é mais forte que os seres humanos.

versos.grego: Βλέπετε γὰρ τὴν κλῆσιν ὑμῶν, ἀδελφοί, ὅτι οὐ πολλοὶ σοφοὶ κατὰ σάρκα, οὐ πολλοὶ δυνατοί, οὐ πολλοὶ εὐγενεῖς·

controles.web: For you see your calling, brothers, that not many are wise according to the flesh, not many mighty, and not many noble;
controles.kjv: For ye see your calling, brethren, how that not many wise men after the flesh, not many mighty, not many noble, are called:
controles.livre: Vede, pois, o vosso chamado, irmãos; pois dentre vós não há muitos sábios segundo a carne, nem muitos poderosos, nem muitos da elite.

versos.grego: ἀλλὰ τὰ μωρὰ τοῦ κόσμου ἐξελέξατο ὁ Θεός ἵνα καταισχύνῃ τοὺς σοφούς, καὶ τὰ ἀσθενῆ τοῦ κόσμου ἐξελέξατο ὁ Θεός ἵνα καταισχύνῃ τὰ ἰσχυρά,

controles.web: but God chose the foolish things of the world that he might put to shame those who are wise. God chose the weak things of the world, that he might put to shame the things that are strong;
controles.kjv: But God hath chosen the foolish things of the world to confound the wise; and God hath chosen the weak things of the world to confound the things which are mighty;
controles.livre: Mas Deus escolheu as coisas loucas deste mundo para envergonhar as sábias; e Deus escolheu as fracas deste mundo, para envergonhar as fortes.

versos.grego: καὶ τὰ ἀγενῆ τοῦ κόσμου καὶ τὰ ἐξουθενημένα ἐξελέξατο ὁ Θεός, τὰ μὴ ὄντα, ἵνα τὰ ὄντα καταργήσῃ,

controles.web: and God chose the lowly things of the world, and the things that are despised, and the things that are not, that he might bring to nothing the things that are:
controles.kjv: And base things of the world, and things which are despised, hath God chosen, yea, and things which are not, to bring to nought things that are:
controles.livre: E Deus escolheu as coisas desprezíveis deste mundo, e as sem valor, e as que não são, para aniquilar as que são.

versos.grego: ὅπως μὴ καυχήσηται πᾶσα σὰρξ ἐνώπιον τοῦ Θεοῦ.

controles.web: that no flesh should boast before God.
controles.kjv: That no flesh should glory in his presence.
controles.livre: Para que ninguém  orgulhe de si diante dele.

versos.grego: ἐξ αὐτοῦ δὲ ὑμεῖς ἐστε ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ, ὃς ἐγενήθη σοφία ἡμῖν ἀπὸ Θεοῦ, δικαιοσύνη τε καὶ ἁγιασμὸς καὶ ἀπολύτρωσις,

controles.web: But of him, you are in Christ Jesus, who was made to us wisdom from God, and righteousness and sanctification, and redemption:
controles.kjv: But of him are ye in Christ Jesus, who of God is made unto us wisdom, and righteousness, and sanctification, and redemption:
controles.livre: Mas vós sois dele em Jesus Cristo, o qual de Deus nos foi feito sabedoria, e justiça, e santificação, e resgate.

versos.grego: ἵνα καθὼς γέγραπται Ὁ καυχώμενος ἐν Κυρίῳ καυχάσθω.

controles.web: that, according as it is written, “He who boasts, let him boast in the Lord.”
controles.kjv: That, according as it is written, He that glorieth, let him glory in the Lord.
controles.livre: Para que, como está escrito: Aquele que se orgulha, orgulhe-se no Senhor.
